title: Understanding L0 Regularization
text: L0 regularization limits the number of non-zero parameters in the model. In this case, only one parameter in the vector \( $$\theta$$ \) can be non-zero.

title: Logistic Regression Basics
text: Logistic regression predicts probabilities using the logistic function \( \sigma(z)=1/(1+e**{-z}) \). The predicted class is $$1$$ if the probability is greater than $$0.5$$, and $$0$$ otherwise.

title: Applying L0 Regularization
text: With \( $$k=1$$ \), only one feature can have a non-zero weight. Consider each feature individually to determine which one minimizes the misclassification error.

title: Calculate Predictions
text: Calculate the predicted probabilities for each color using the logistic function with each feature having a non-zero weight one at a time. Which feature results in the least misclassification?
